main_text.p: be Thimnath, quae à Iosua Daniae tribui ascribitur, sed quae nondum ab ea occupata tempore Samsonis esset: consilio Dei, & consen-su parentum: quibus non consultis (funt.n. honorandi) fas non erat liberos matrimonia inire.

Sic parentum consilio vxores duxerunt Isaac, Gen.24. Ismael, Gen.21. Iacob, Gen.29. Sichem, Gen.28. Her, Gen.38. Dauid, 1.Reg.18. Tobias, idq; iussu angeli, Tob.7.8. & hoc loco Samson, & alij pij homines. Et eam auctoritatem, vt ex parentum iudicio & voluntate liberi vxores ducant, Moses parentibus quoq; tribuit, cum Exod.34. cap. inquit: Nec vxores de filiabus eorum accipies filijs tuis. Et Paulus 1.Corin.7. Qui matrimonio iungit virginem suam, bene facit. Apparet quoq; ex Ecclesiasticis scriptoribus hunc morem à patrib. receptum, semper in Ecclesia & populo Dei obseruatum, ne liberi sine parentum consensu connubia inirent. Sic enim Tertul. lib.2. ad vxorem scribit: Nā nec in terris, filij sine consensu patrum rite & iure nubent. Et Ambrosius citans Euripidis versus in Andromacha, cum Orestes Hermionis connubium petit, ostendit hanc rem non ad suum, sed patris arbitrium pertinere. Ad legitimam ergo coniunctionem vnius maris & vnius fœminae non solum necesse est, vt earum personarum coniunctio fiat, quae sit nepharia & legibus prohibita (id quod & exemplum Corinthij monet 1. Cor.5.) & vt contractus fiat vtriusque[?]

page.notes: Running head and page number read from the top of the page. Signature "K 2" read from the foot; the final numeral is slightly unclear. Line-end hyphens restored where the printer marked them ("confen-su", "consen-su" joined as printed in the sense). The word "ascribitur" is split across lines without a printed hyphen and is written whole. The last word "vtriufquè" is printed with an accent that may be misread; marked [?]. Long s rendered as plain s throughout. The opening fragment "be Thimnath" is printed as a line fragment and is kept as such.
